title: 7 Best Herbal Creams For Laryngitis
intro: Herbal creams for Laryngitis are topical ointments or creams made from plant extracts that aim to provide relief from the symptoms of laryngitis, an inflammation of the vocal cords. These creams are beneficial as they offer soothing and cooling effects to the affected area, reducing discomfort and pain associated with laryngitis. Some examples of herbal creams used to treat laryngitis include aloe vera cream, which helps to reduce inflammation and promote healing, chamomile cream, which provides a calming effect, and echinacea cream, which has anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, herbal creams containing ingredients such as slippery elm, licorice root, and marshmallow root are also effective in treating laryngitis due to their mucilaginous properties, which help to protect and soothe the mucous membranes in the throat.

preparations.preparation_desc: Eucalyptus globulus creams have been traditionally used to treat laryngitis due to their decongestant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to reduce swelling and ease congestion in the throat. The bioactive constituents of Eucalyptus globulus, such as eucalyptol, limonene, and pinene, possess antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties that help to combat the underlying infection and alleviate symptoms of laryngitis. By applying Eucalyptus globulus creams topically, the bioactive constituents can be absorbed through the skin and mucous membranes, providing relief from inflammation, pain, and discomfort associated with laryngitis. The benefits of using Eucalyptus globulus creams to treat laryngitis include rapid relief from symptoms, reduced inflammation, and promotion of a healthy respiratory system.

The benefits of using Echinacea purpurea creams to treat laryngitis include quick relief from symptoms, reduced risk of complications, and a shorter duration of illness, making it a popular natural remedy for this condition.

preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of the Medical Association of Thailand = Chotmaihet thangphaet", Glycyrrhiza glabra creams for laryngitis show strong antimicrobial activity, particularly against S. pyogenes, S. pneumoniae, and S. mutans with MIC values ranging from 39-156 μg/ml and MBC values ranging from 78-312 μg/ml.
